panels.title: HTTP requests
panels.description: Incoming 2md API requests in the selected time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and r._field == "request_count")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Target URLs
panels.description: Includes batch_count for batch API requests. Per-domain batch attribution uses the first URL in the batch.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and r._field == "target_count")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: 4xx + 5xx rate
panels.description: Client and server responses with status code 400 or above.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and (r._field == "error_count" or r._field == "request_count"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
data
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: r.error_count) / float(v: r.request_count) * 100.0}))

panels.title: Average request latency
panels.description: Weighted average from request-level duration aggregates.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and (r._field == "duration_ms_sum" or r._field == "request_count"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
data
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: r.duration_ms_sum) / float(v: r.request_count) / 1000.0}))

panels.title: Requests by target domain
panels.description: Batch requests are attributed to their first target domain in the current request log schema.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and r._field == "request_count" and r.domain != "unknown" and r.domain != "serp:search")
  |> group(columns: ["domain", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["domain"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and r._field == "request_count")
  |> group(columns: ["status_code", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["status_code"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Top target domains
panels.description: Domain labels come from request logs; per-domain batch attribution uses the first URL.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and r._field == "request_count" and r.domain != "unknown" and r.domain != "serp:search")
  |> group(columns: ["domain"])
  |> sum()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> keep(columns: ["domain", "_value"])

panels.title: Average request latency by target domain
panels.description: Latency is for the whole API request; batch requests are attributed to their first target domain.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and (r._field == "duration_ms_sum" or r._field == "request_count") and r.domain != "unknown" and r.domain != "serp:search")
  |> group(columns: ["domain", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["domain"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["domain"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({domain: r.domain, _value: float(v: r.duration_ms_sum) / float(v: r.request_count) / 1000.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)

panels.title: P95 request latency by domain
panels.description: P95 is calculated per minute/domain/status/batch group, then shows the maximum group P95 for each domain and time window.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "url2md_request_minute" and r._field == "duration_ms_p95" and r.domain != "unknown" and r.domain != "serp:search")
  |> group(columns: ["domain", "_time"])
  |> max()
  |> group(columns: ["domain"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
